data.name: Mignon
data.gender_notes: Mignon is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the French word 'mignon', which means 'delightful' or 'cute'. This name was popular in France during the Middle Ages and was often given to girls. It is a diminutive of the name Marie. The name Mignon carries the meaning “Petite, dainty, dear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mignon usually hope their child will grow to embody petite, dainty, dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mignon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Petite, dainty, dear one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mignon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mignon carries a charming and endearing connotation, which has made it a popular choice among parents for their daughters. Its French origin adds an exotic and sophisticated touch to the name. Historically, it was a sign of affection in French culture, and girls named Mignon were often spoiled and pampered, making the name symbolize love and care.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mignon carries a spiritual significance in the context of being delightful and precious in the eyes of God. It reflects a deep appreciation for the beauty of creation and the people in our lives. The name can be a reminder to cherish and value each moment and relationship, treating others with love and kindness as children of God. Additionally, it can be a personal reminder of our own value and worth as beloved creations of the divine.
